$comment: Per-shot settings for tools/photo/clean_lightbox.py. Coordinates are pixels in the oriented original. F01 three-quarter (A2) from the wearer's right; the near temple runs off the left edge, so the photographer's crop is kept. The engraved wordmark and old emblem on the blue tortoise temple come off stroke by stroke (rebuilding the whole patch would smear the tortoise). The GCD is placed on the right temple with tools/photo/temple_gcd.py (gcd.measured_with): the temple's edges converge well here, so its face is modelled in 3D, and the model gets the old print's proportions right.

marks.name: engraved wordmark and old emblem, near temple (inset from the temple's edges, which the stroke detector would otherwise take for strokes)
